description: Liberia - Maryland, Nimba and Grand Gedeh County Existing grid lines is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Columbia University Earth Institute. The the cross-border MV systems lines extend from neighboring countries into Liberia. It was derived from a Government of Norway, World Bank, USAID & JICA funded study and brochures provided by LEC in 2012 ( World Bank. Scope and Rough Cost Estimate for Recovering Pre-War T&D System Capacity. Coverage: Liberia. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, SHP. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2012 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
